theorem pentagonal_number_theorem [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [T2Space R]
    [IsTopologicalRing R] :
  ∏' n : ℕ, (1 - X ^ (n + 1)) = PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    if h : ∃ k : ℤ, pentagonal k = m then
      if Even (Classical.choose h) then (1 : R) else (-1 : R)
    else
      0 := sorry
